# Tension coupon test - synthetic fixture

SYNTHETIC MATERIAL - authored for the LabCairn public fixture corpus.
The coupon, the instrument and every number in this notebook are
invented for testing; no physical experiment is represented here.

## Specimen

Specimen B-2 is a synthetic coupon, nominally 2.0 mm thick, with a
gauge length of 50 mm. The material's certificate of analysis was not
available for this exercise.

## Method

The pull was performed at a crosshead speed of 0.5 mm/min.
Three replicate pulls were recorded for specimen B-2, and their peak
stresses are tabulated in measurements.csv.

## Units

Peak stress is reported in megapascals. The gauge length column in
measurements.csv is millimetres and takes no part in the stress
calculation.
